Market today: The mood is cautious, driven by Fed comments that offered no clear rate signal but praised global tightening. This, combined with Barclays' warning that the best of the AI trade might be behind us, creates headwinds for your concentrated tech/chip book.

Your holdings: Several positions demand immediate attention. SMCI (-20.03%), MUU (-26.06%), SOXL (-52.24%), and SPAL (-35.19%) are all trading below their stated stops. Given your margin use, these leveraged positions amplify losses and require swift action.

Watch: Keep a close eye on overall tech sector performance, especially chip names, following the AI trade warning. Also, monitor any further Fed commentary for clearer policy direction.

Bottom line: Prioritize strict risk management on your leveraged and below-stop positions to protect capital in this uncertain environment.
plays: Consider exiting or significantly trimming SMCI, MUU, SOXL, and SPAL immediately, as they are all trading below their stops and are flagged as SELL.
No new buys today - hold and watch. The market mood and specific warnings on AI suggest caution over initiating new positions.
